title: escalate and P1 escalation.submit: request
description: An escalation from a live attempt: the built-in tool escalate, or P1 escalation.submit for a job worker; at most one per attempt. The fields are closed; the subject is the own worker, the own task tree or a catalog resource of the task scope (MGR-5). note is untrusted: neither the lens nor the manager sees it. The lease token goes in the Botaru-Lease header.

note.description: Untrusted note; only the tenant people see it in P2.
